plotSections.title: The Lantern's Ethereal Veil at the Stronghold
bullets: The activated lantern overlays the stronghold with a hazy, semi-three-dimensional mix of the party's world and another dimension, reminiscent of the realm Sylan enters with his sword but only glanced into; everyone inside the stronghold can see it.

When Sylan opens the door to rejoin the party, the door frame collapses into impenetrable blackness and Sylan appears as a faint silvery outline made of shadows and hard silver lines; an unrecognizable spirit standing outside the door is pulled into him with a howl, seen only by Sylan.
This activation feels different from the last: purely silent and dewy rather than a mix of two experiences.
Sylan confirms that spirits are drawn into him by proximity, like a magnet, without needing touch (including the six souls in town and the one at the door).

plotSections.title: The Soul Fragment in Walker's Helm
bullets: Sylan sees damp, wisp-like ectoplasm clinging to Walker's helm; under the focused lantern light it gives only a wordless wail, described as the aftertaste of a tortured soul, related to but much weaker than the tortured souls Sylan met in Nyx and Gilbrick.
With Walker's consent, Sylan pulls the fragment out; Walker passes a Wisdom save (15, plus 4 from Ord's aura = 19).

Walker and Sylan share a vision: a young, physically prime hobgoblin Grixto (the Emperor as Walker saw him) walks through Walker, stops beside Sylan, gives Walker a curt, respectful nod in silence, then dissolves into Sylan.
Afterward the helm grows colder, the metal shifts and settles, and it feels like it has lost something; the ectoplasm is gone.
Dana freezes at the table, staring between the helm and Sylan, lips moving soundlessly.

chronologicalEvents: The lantern's activation overlays the stronghold with a hazy dual-dimension view visible to everyone inside.
Sylan opens the door; the frame collapses into blackness and a spirit outside is drawn into him with a howl.
Sylan returns as a silvery, shadowy outline; Walker can see and hear him.
Sylan spots ectoplasm on Walker's helm; Walker sets the helm on the table.
Sylan focuses the lantern on the helm, which gives a wordless wail like the aftertaste of a tortured soul.
Dana freezes, staring between the helm and Sylan, mouthing silently.
Sylan extracts the fragment; Walker succeeds on a Wisdom save with Ord's aura.
Walker and Sylan share a vision of young Grixto nodding respectfully to Walker before dissolving into Sylan.
The helm grows colder and feels diminished; the ectoplasm is gone.
Sylan scans the room for more souls; Dana remains deathly pale and muttering.

notes: While the lantern is active, Sylan appears as a semi-transparent silvery outline of shadows and hard silver lines, trailing shadowy wisps.
Spirits are drawn into him by proximity like a magnet; no touch is required.
Absorbed a spirit standing outside the stronghold door, which only he witnessed.
Extracted a Grixto soul fragment from Walker's helm; the fragment dissolved into him.
personality: Treats soul collecting as his job, joking about a nine-to-five.
quotesThemes: "Have a job after all. Nine to five."

notes: His helm carried a soul fragment of Grixto; he passed the Wisdom save during extraction and shared the vision of young Grixto, who nodded respectfully to him.
Freezes and goes deathly white upon seeing the helm and the extraction, mouthing words silently and appearing to recognize something.
Is distressed in the lantern's ethereal state, feeling angry, scared, and alone; he cowers in the back.
Ord's aura granted Walker +4 on the Wisdom save within 30 feet.
A soul fragment of Grixto lingered in Walker's helm.
In the vision he appears as a young, spry hobgoblin in his prime, the Emperor as Walker saw him; he nods respectfully to Walker before dissolving into Sylan.
Was coated in ectoplasm from a soul fragment that wailed under the lantern's light.
After extraction it is colder, its metal has shifted, and it feels as though it has lost something.
Square medieval lantern lit on all sides; its activation overlays the stronghold with a hazy view of another dimension, resembling Sylan's sword realm but only glanced into.
Doors opened while it is active collapse into blackness.
Focusing its light on an object reveals residual souls.

misTranscriptions.notes: Dana glancing between the helm and Sylan

openQuestions: What did Dana recognize in the helm and the extraction that left her frozen?

newTerms.name: Soul goo
notes: Walker's name for the ectoplasmic residue of a soul fragment, visible under the lantern.
